verdict.rationale: Shopify's own marketing documents a professionally designed theme store and says merchants can pick a prebuilt theme and then customize it, which covers the core of launching a storefront from themes. It does not document how customization works: there is no evidence of a no-code editor, section or layout editing, or branding controls. Missing for 10: documented no-code theme editor, explicit layout/section customization, branding controls (colors/fonts/logo), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can launch a polished storefront from professionally designed themes and customize layout, sections, and branding without code

citations.quote: Look for a design with the features you need most, then customize from there
